description_expanded: ABOUT BASK: Welcome to Bask, a 2nd floor one level condo with amazing views of the Gulf right from your living room and large private balcony. This 2-bedroom / 2 bath beachfront condo is located in the Ramsgate Harbour Community on the quiet West End of Panama City Beach and offers plenty of space for a family or small group to come down and vacation. Sleeping 6 comfortably, the Master bedroom offers fantastic views of the gulf and is equipped with a King size bed, flat screen television and a full en-suite bathroom. In the guest bedroom you will find two Queen beds perfect to sleep extra family members! The open kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need to cook a delicious meal. There is a table with seating for six and seating outside on the spacious patio. This unit comes complete with a full-size washer and dryer. The open floor plan makes the direct gulf views at this property even that much more enjoyable! If you are looking for peace and serenity on a quiet beach and a short stroll to all of the action, then you have found your Dream Vacation! ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Private Beach PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Community gulf front pool. * Private beach. * Gulf views. PARKING: * $35 per registered Vehicle PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties, and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build lasting memories for all our guests. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
